segments.text: Hey everyone! Batch 3 mein daily allowance aur claims sikhenge. Fokus hai central government
civilian official travel. Example, level 7 officer train, hotel aur food alak chek kari.
Har example, hypothetical hai. Latest order aur sanction verify kari.
Eek important correction. Pehle batches mein ye train order miss hua tha. 30 August 2023 ka DOE
order chek kare. Vande Bharat ki entitlement shatabdi jaisi hai, Hamsafar ki entitlement
rajdhani jaisi hai. Ye tour, training, transfer aur retirement journeys par apply huta hai.
Example, level 7 ke liye eligible chair card chek karein.
Food component ki liye bill submit nahi karene hote.
Har calendar day ki absence se percentage tha hote hain.
6 hours se kum par 30%, 6 se 12 par 70, 12 hour se upar 100%.
Example, level 7 par 7 hours ka food saath so rupah hain.
Absence midnight se midnight, har din alag count hoti hai. Example, level 7 tour rath aat se
subhe paaj tak hai. Pehle din 4 hours, agle din 5 hours hai. Dono par 30%, yani 300 plus
300. Total food component 600 rupees ho ga. Baaki conditions check karen.
Agar boarding aur lodging do no free ho, special rule dekhayin. Purana 25% daily allowance
bandh hai, eligible local travel par kharch ho to rules ke according claim ho sakta hai.
Example, official city ride mein 200 rupee kharch huay, entitlement aur proof check karke
vahi actual expense claim karein.
Lekin sirf free breakfast ko dono free manna sahi nahi hai.
Partial meals ke liye is order se fixed percentage assume na karein.
Example, hotel breakfast free hai dinner khud pe kya.
Specific applicable instruction accounts office se konform karein.
Hotel ceiling geek maximum hai. Automatic payment nahi. Level 8 tak general rule mein self-certification
available hai. Example, level 7 ka eligible room cost 800 rupai hai. Tab room claim 800
hai. Pura ceiling nahi. Class X city ki higher limit ke liye vouchers chahiye.
Hotel tax is entitlement ke upar reimburs ho sakte hai. GST actual charge ke eligible
hisse par calculate hota hai. Example, artso room aur hypothetical 12% tax. Tax chiyan
way, total artso chiyan way. Conditions lagu. Actual GST rate aur invoice account se chek
karen.
Level 9-11 ka city travel mein voucher waver hai.
Self-certification mein travel period aur vehicle number likhen.
Example, level 10 officer ki eligible non-AC ride 350 hai.
Claim actual kharj ke liye hai. Ceiling ki fixed payment nahi.
Ek purani clarifikation mein airport transfers alak discuss hain, likin uska aaj ka application
accounts office se verify karein. Example, airport se hotel aur hotel se meeting alak rides
hain. Ek hi ride ko do baar kliym mat karein.
Local journey mein normal duty point se distance chekk karen. Government training material 8 km radius ka test batata hai.
Example, temporary office normal office se 8 km ke bahar hai.
Ghar si distance deek kar hi final decision mat liin.
Example, level 7 aur 7 hours par amount 350.
Lekin original 2018 letter ki verified copy nahi mili.
Isli actual claim se pehli account se confirm karein.
Specific scientific and data collection fieldwork ke liye clause hai. Rate food component ke
equivalent ho sakta hai. Head of department ya controlling officer ka approval
zeroori hai. Example, remote survey mein team foot ya mule se ja rahi hai.
Har ship journey ko automatic extra payment madh samjhen.
Food journey ke liye base rate 12 rupee per kilometre tha.
Pehle 25% increase ke baat 15 rupee hota hai.
Example, eligible journey me 4 kilometre sach mein paidal chale.
4 into 15 i.e. 60 rupee. Conditions check karein.
Claim pack mein sanction, level, journey dates aur tickets rakhhen. Hotel aur city travel ke rules alag hai.
Example, level 10 hotel receipt rakhhen, city ride self-certify karen. Food component ke liye alag food vouchers nahi chahiye.
Submit karne ka acknowledgement bhi samhal kar rakhhen.
Toor ka boarding pass missing hotu prescribe declaration dekhin.
Level 10 aur nichek controlling officer counter-sign kartein.
Example, level 10 officer form bharkar counter-sign karwai.
Actual journey aur no duplicate claim honestly declare karein.
Tour, transfer aur training claim ki limit 60 days hai.
Retirement claim ke liye order ne 180 days kiye.
Journey ke baat agle din se clock shuru hone ka rule dekhayin.
Example, 1 march tour end ho, claim 2 march due hota hai.
Last day ka weight na karein, late clean par forfeature hosakta hai.
Apna controlling officer huni par treasury ya cash section dekhhe. Baaki cases mein head of
office ya controlling officer ko submit karein. Example, officer ne samay par head of office
ko clean diya. Dated acknowledgement se submission ki date prove ho sakti hai. Eek saalsi zyada
abiens ka review automatic waiver nahi hai.
Toor advance liya hai to ek alag deadline chek karein.
Compendium rule 51 mein 15 days adjustment likha hai.
Toor complete ya uske baat duty resume honeki date dekhain.
Example, advance wala officer jaldi adjustment bill submit karein.
Late hone par recovery ya interest laksakta hai.
Dearness allowance 50% hune par kuch rates bade. Example, level 7 food 800 se 1000 hua.
60% DA atte hi, 2ra increase automatikli nahi hota.
